title: Associate Product Configuration Engineer
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


**Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, test, and support Industrial Automation System configuration and selection tools.
* Design and implement product configurators based on product marketing specifications and business requirements.
* Organize, manage, and maintain product and configuration data from various databases for integration into electronic marketing and sales tools.
* Work closely with Product Marketing teams to clarify configurator requirements and implement enhancements resulting from product reviews.
* Develop and maintain server\-based web applications supporting product configuration and selection processes.
* Create, test, and deploy configurator solutions in enterprise configurator environments.
* Perform database programming activities, including data modeling, maintenance, optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Participate in software release, validation, testing, and deployment activities.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and engineering teams, on a daily basis to deliver quality solutions.
* Ensure configurator accuracy, performance, documentation, and compliance with established development standards.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to automation product knowledge development.

**The Essentials \- You Will Have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 1\-4 years of software development and maintenance experience.
* Experience working on live software development projects and production support activities.
* Strong experience with database programming and data management concepts.
* Good knowledge of software application development, testing methodologies, and technical documentation.
* Experience working in product configurator development environments.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks independently and work effectively with globally distributed teams.
* Flexibility to support U.S. time zones during software release and testing activities.

**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have**

* Knowledge of Industrial Automation products, preferably Rockwell Automation products or equivalent competitor offerings.
* Hands\-on experience with declarative product model programming in configurator platforms CPQ such as:
	+ SAP Variant Configuration (SAP VC)
	+ Selectica
	+ (Oracle CPQ)
	+ Configit
	+ Tacton

* Experience in creating and maintaining product configurators like online product configuration solutions.
* Strong knowledge of MS Access, SQL, and Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with server\-based web application development and maintenance.
* Ability to interpret product configuration specifications and translate them into effective configurator solutions.
* Experience working closely with Product Marketing teams to define requirements and implement configuration changes.
* Exposure to product lifecycle management, product data management, and configuration testing processes.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions with business users, product managers, and external partners.
* Strong desire to continuously learn Industrial Automation products and emerging technologies.

**What We Offer**

Our benefits package includes:


* Opportunities to work on global Industrial Automation products and technologies.
* Exposure to enterprise\-scale product configurator platforms and digital engineering solutions.
* Professional development and continuous learning opportunities.
* Collaboration with global engineering, product management, and technology teams.
* A flexible and inclusive work environment that supports innovation and career growth.

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Growth Manager- D2C (E-commerce)
description:
**Category / Growth Manager — D2C**


*One growth loop: bring demand in shape the assortment price \& promote time it to the devotional calendar. You own all four.*


**Experience:** 4–5 years


**About AppsForBharat**


AppsForBharat, a series C\-funded faith\-tech startup, is backed by India’s best venture capital investors including Fundamentum, Susquehanna Asia VC, Peak XV partners (prev. Sequoia Capital), Elevation Capital, \& BEENEXT. Our highly ambitious and audacious team comprises alumni from prestigious institutions like IITs \& IIMs, with extensive experience in scaling high\-growth startups. We're dedicated to developing mobile and web apps catering to the devotional and spiritual needs of 100s of millions of users across the globe.


Our flagship product, **Sri Mandir**, launched in November 2020, is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees. It serves as a digital sanctuary for millions of devotees worldwide. Our mission is to enrich individuals' spiritual lives through innovative technology, offering seamless access to sacred pilgrims \& rituals, divine teachings, and a vibrant community. The overwhelming user love motivates us as we aim to serve 100s of millions more in the coming years.


The devotion market is a $44B opportunity in India (growing at 10% CAGR), which is primarily offline and unorganised. Of the $44B, the temples drive GMV of \~$27B in temple offerings, services, and commerce. There are 2M\+ temples in India \- about 10k of these temples have a strong historical and cultural significance. Tourism to these religious places is a $10B opportunity. The Sri Mandir app is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees and growing 20\-25% month\-on\-month.

  


Try the Sri Mandir app: **Android** / **iOS**
  

  

**Role Overview**


You own **growth and category** for Srimandir's own D2C channel end\-to\-end.
  

It's a full\-loop role: you **generate the demand**, decide the **assortment** (how deep within a category, how wide across categories), set the **price and promotion**, and orchestrate all of it against India's **devotional calendar**, the rhythm that drives this business. You run the store like a P\&L and grow it.


**What you'll own**


**1 · Category — vertical \& horizontal thinking.** Build the assortment on two axes:


* **Vertical (go deep):** depth and premium ladders within winning categories, drive the NPD pipeline (new SKUs, variants, price tiers).
* **Horizontal (go wide):** expand into new categories, cross\-sell and basket expansion — decide what to add, what to scale, and what to cut.

**2 · Pricing \& promotion.** Set the pricing and margin architecture per category; design the discounting, offers and bundling that grow volume without eroding margin.


**3 · Calendar planning.** Build and run the festive / muhurat / seasonal calendar (Sawan, Navratri, Diwali and the rest) as the operating rhythm \- plan launches, campaigns, inventory and promotions against each peak, well ahead of time.


**4 · Demand generation (Marketing).** Own the funnel end\-to\-end \- traffic (performance marketing across Meta / Google), on\-site / in\-app conversion, and repeat (CRM, notifications, WhatsApp). Partner with performance and creative teams; own the growth number, CAC and ROAS.

  

  

**What success looks like (first 6–12 months)**


* D2C revenue and growth at or above plan; category contribution up.
* AOV and repeat\-purchase rate rising, with healthy CAC / ROAS.
* Margin held while scaling volume, pricing and promo discipline.
* Calendar\-led launches shipped on time, with demand captured at each festival peak.

**What you bring**


* 4–6 years in category management, growth, or D2C e\-commerce \- **deally a mix of category ownership and demand generation.**
* Performance\-marketing fluency \- run or closely partnered on Meta / Google plus CRM / retention.
* Pricing and P\&L comfort; a sharp assortment / NPD instinct (vertical depth \+ horizontal expansion).
* Data\-driven \- strong analytics; makes decisions from funnel and category data.

**Nice to have**


* D2C consumer\-brand / FMCG / e\-commerce background; app or store growth experience.
* Feel for festive, seasonal, calendar\-driven categories.
* Affinity for the spiritual / devotional space and Indian consumer nuance (Hinglish a plus).

The **Site Operations \& Inventory Control Manager** will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end ecommerce fulfillment site operations, including inbound, putaway, inventory control, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, stock reconciliation, vendor discrepancy reporting, manpower productivity, SLA adherence, and SOP compliance.The role will act as the **single point of ownership for site performance, inventory accuracy, inbound quality, process discipline, and operational issue resolution**. The person will ensure that the warehouse operates efficiently, stock records remain accurate, and all incoming and outgoing inventory movements are controlled as per brand standards.

**You should apply if you have:**

* A strong interest in Site Operations and Inventory Control Management.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills for ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to work in fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Ownership\-driven attitude—comfortable taking charge of projects end\-to\-end
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines

**You should not apply if you:**

* Struggle with ownership and require constant supervision to drive tasks
* Are uncomfortable working with data, numbers, or analytical problem\-solving
* Are not willing to collaborate with cross\-functional teams or external partners
* Avoid negotiation, communication, or vendor/brand interaction

**Skills Required**

* Strong understanding of ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations.
* Good command over inbound, GRN, inventory control, dispatch, returns, and audit processes.
* Knowledge of SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, barcode, PO, invoice, ASN, GRN, and stock adjustment processes.
* Strong attention to detail and counting accuracy.
* Ability to identify stock discrepancies, quality issues, and process gaps.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets / MIS reporting skills.
* Understanding of WMS, OMS, ERP, and courier systems; Vinculum knowledge preferred.
* Ability to manage third\-party manpower and ensure SOP compliance.

**What you will do:**

**1\. End\-to\-End Site Operations Management**

* Own daily warehouse / darkstore operations including inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and inventory control.
* Ensure orders are processed within defined cut\-off times and SLA timelines.
* Monitor daily order volume, pending orders, aging orders, SLA breaches, and operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with central operations, logistics, product, inventory planning, procurement, finance, and customer support teams.
* Ensure smooth order fulfilment across B2C, marketplace, darkstore, and other ecommerce channels, wherever applicable.

**2\. SLA \& Performance Management**

* Track and improve key operational metrics, including order processing TAT, dispatch TAT, pick\-pack accuracy, inventory accuracy, manpower productivity, and order breach percentage.
* Review site performance daily through dashboards, MIS, exception reports, and pending trackers.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive corrective actions.
* Prepare daily / weekly performance updates for leadership review.
* Highlight operational risks proactively with root cause and action plan.

**3\. Inventory Accuracy \& Stock Governance**

* Ensure accurate stock storage, bin mapping, SKU hygiene, batch tracking, expiry tracking, FEFO / FIFO adherence, and stock reconciliation.
* Conduct and supervise daily, weekly, and monthly cycle counts as per audit plan.
* Verify physical stock against system stock at SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, and bin level.
* Identify stock mismatches, short / excess quantities, wrong bin placements, missing labels, unscannable barcodes, and location errors.
* Monitor shrinkage, damaged stock, expired stock, dead stock, slow\-moving stock, and high\-value inventory.
* Ensure expired, damaged, leaked, or unsellable stock is quarantined and marked correctly.
* Maintain strict controls for high\-value, fast\-moving, fragile, and expiry\-sensitive SKUs.

**4\. Inbound Audit \& GRN Control**

* Audit incoming stock against PO, invoice, ASN, delivery challan, and system records.
* Verify SKU name, SKU code, quantity, batch number, expiry date, MRP, barcode, and packaging condition.
* Ensure received stock matches system expectations before GRN closure.
* Identify shortages, excess quantity, wrong SKUs, duplicate items, damaged products, near\-expiry stock, expired stock, leakage, tampering, or invoice mismatch.
* Validate GRN entries for accuracy and ensure all discrepancies are recorded before stock acceptance.
* Prevent unauthorized inwarding of stock without PO or required approval.
* Ensure only audited and approved stock moves to putaway.

**5\. Vendor, Transporter \& Discrepancy Management**

* Report vendor\-side and transporter\-side issues such as wrong dispatch, short supply, excess supply, damaged goods, expiry mismatch, MRP mismatch, or invoice mismatch.
* Capture proper evidence through photos, quantity records, signed discrepancy notes, and audit reports.
* Maintain inbound discrepancy logs, rejection reports, vendor issue reports, damage reports, and GRN correction records.
* Coordinate with procurement, planning, finance, and warehouse teams for discrepancy closure.
* Track vendor discrepancy closure and ensure repeated issues are escalated with data.

**6\. Putaway, Storage \& Bin Discipline**

* Ensure stock is moved from the receiving area to the correct storage / bin location within defined TAT.
* Validate correct labeling, barcode scanning, batch tagging, expiry marking, and SKU placement before storage.
* Prevent wrong putaway of unaudited or rejected stock.
* Ensure bin accuracy across racks, storage zones, pick faces, and bulk locations.
* Identify mixed SKUs, wrong bin mapping, wrong batch placement, and missing labels.
* Coordinate correction of bin\-level discrepancies with warehouse team.

**7\. Team \& Manpower Management**

* Monitor whether warehouse staff, supervisors, pickers, packers, auditors, and third\-party manpower are following brand\-defined SOPs.
* Plan manpower as per order load, sale days, campaigns, and business peaks.
* Conduct daily briefings to align teams on order priorities, pending workload, SLA risks, and process discipline.
* Track manpower productivity and identify areas of underutilization or bottleneck.
* Ensure clear shift\-wise ownership for inbound, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and audits.

**8\. Process Compliance \& Site Audit**

* Ensure SOP adherence across inbound, storage, putaway, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, and stock adjustment processes.
* Perform site audits in accordance with brand guidelines.
* Maintain documentation for audits, stock movements, damages, GRN, dispatches, returns, rejected stock, and stock adjustments.
* Ensure all stock adjustments are properly documented and approved as per the process.
* Support internal and external audits with required data and records.
* Ensure safety, hygiene, security, and compliance standards are followed at the site.

**9\. Returns \& Reverse Inventory Control**

* Ensure returned stock is received, audited, QC\-checked, and moved to the correct inventory status.
* Validate return discrepancies such as wrong item received, missing item, damaged item, used product, or non\-sellable return.
* Track return\-to\-sellable %, return QC TAT, and rejected return stock.
* Coordinate with customer support, logistics, and finance teams for return closure and refund\-related dependencies.

**10\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation**

* Act as the first escalation point for site\-level operational and inventory\-related issues.
* Resolve issues related to stock mismatch, GRN errors, order delays, manpower shortage, courier handover delays, return discrepancies, system discrepancies, and damaged stock.
* Prepare RCA for repeated inventory mismatches, inbound discrepancies, dispatch delays, and SOP deviations.
* Escalate critical risks proactively with data, business impact, and corrective action plan.

**Work Experience**

**3–5 years** in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, inventory control, inbound operations, stock audit, darkstore operations, retail fulfillment, supply chain operations, FMCG, supplement, pharma\-like product handling, or logistics operations.Experience in a **D2C, ecommerce, supplement, FMCG, pharma, beauty, or personal care warehouse** will be preferred because these categories require tighter control over expiry, batch, MRP, damage, leakage, and return quality.
